title: Measure: reads per node

checklist.step: Recompute actual reads on unfamiliar sizes and shapes
Draw the measured sizes and counts

hints: Write down what one completed call must return.
Check the leaf case independently of its label.
Use child answers to establish the contract at their parent.

questions.prompt: If each node supplies one label read, what is reads divided by n?

choices.why: Depth bounds a path, not all visited nodes.
Internal nodes also supply label reads.
n reads divided by n nodes equals 1.
